headline: SQM Q3 Profit Triples on Lithium Price Surge, Warns on Q4 Prices
summary: SQM reported its Q3 profit tripled, driven by surging lithium prices and solid demand, though it warned of lower prices ahead in the fourth quarter.
why: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile is one of the world's largest lithium and fertilizer producers, making its earnings a key barometer for the electric vehicle battery supply chain.

impacts.name: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile
impacts.why: Strong Q3 earnings and revenue growth directly benefit the company's financial standing.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Tripled profits and strong revenue growth driven by higher lithium prices exceeded expectations, boosting investor sentiment despite warnings of lower Q4 prices.
